event_name: Date 14 April 2019 Time 14:45 2019 CHINESE GRAND PRIX 11 - 14 April 2019 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
offence: Involved in an incident as defined by Article 38.1 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
penalty: Drive through penalty. (2 penalty points awarded, 2 points in total for the 12 month period)
reason: The Stewards reviewed video evidence and concluded that the driver of car 26, (Daniil Kvyat), lost control of his car at the exit of turn 6 and hit the cars to his left. He did this on his own and the Stewards determined that he was wholly at fault, causing the collision.
rules_referenced: Article 38.1 of the FIA Formula One Sporting
title: Offence Car 26 Causing A Collision In Turn 6
